rationale: cartservice logs 417 'FailedPrecondition ... Can't access cart storage' errors, and its socket count (+37%, z=+7.46), memory, and CPU all rose, while frontend errors (z=+20) match the roughly 421 'request error' lines, so the errors appear to propagate from cartservice. Socket is the largest cartservice anomaly, but cartservice mem and cpu also moved and the digest does not clearly separate the fault types, so the fault type is a best guess.

proposed_fix.description: Inspect cartservice's connections to its cart storage backend (likely Redis) and restart or reconfigure the cartservice pods if sockets are leaking or exhausted. Review connection pool limits and the OverflowException source.
